method: Generated illustrations; Wikipedia research context and existing collection image as style reference.

portraits.author: Clarice Lispector
portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square literary portrait of Clarice Lispector: mature Brazilian novelist with distinctive almond-shaped intense eyes, sharply defined cheekbones and nose, side-parted swept-back shoulder-length hair and small earrings, thoughtful direct gaze. Research context https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clarice_Lispector. Attached Mistral portrait is STYLE ONLY, not the subject: draw Clarice Lispector's own recognizable facial identity, do not copy Mistral's face. Match the refined classic black pen on warm ivory paper aesthetic. User specifically requests sketch-like MORE VISIBLE PEN TRACES: expressive thin-to-thick hand-drawn marks, repeated searching contour strokes along face and jaw, irregular curved hatching and diagonal crosshatch bundles, loosely scribbled hair, airy unfinished shoulders, occasional angular construction lines. Keep ivory paper visible between strokes. Facial shading must be formed by drawn lines, not smooth photographic shading or uniform stippled dots. A dignified recognizable portrait with realistic proportions, no caricature or cartoon. Tight head-and-shoulders square composition, entire head visible, plain ivory background, no text, no frame, no watermark.
